title: Amazon Influencer Program Apply: Requirements, Storefront Setup, and Approval Walkthrough
summary: Learn how to apply for the Amazon Influencer Program, pass social account review, unlock onsite commissions, and launch your Amazon storefront.
body_markdown:
## Mastering the Amazon Creator Hub: Storefront Setup and Onsite Commission Readiness


After you complete the **[amazon influencer program apply](https://www.amazon.com/b?ie=UTF8&node=51812349011)** process and receive storefront access, organize the creator workspace. The Amazon Creator Hub connects your storefront, idea lists, shoppable videos, earnings data, and account settings. A clear structure helps shoppers find relevant recommendations, while accurate tracking links protect affiliate attribution.


### Navigating the Amazon Influencer Login and Creator Hub Portal


Use the Amazon account associated with your approved social profile to access the Amazon influencer login. Amazon may route you through the Creator Hub, Associates Central, or your Amazon storefront login. Check the account email, creator name, and storefront handle before changing settings.


### Building Your Amazon Storefront: From Basics to Branding


Choose a storefront identity that matches your public creator account. Add a profile image, concise bio, and recommendation groups organized by shopper need. Useful themes include apartment organization, beginner camera equipment, travel accessories, kitchen tools, or products tested during a routine. Give each list a clear title, explanation, and products that belong together.


For creators learning *how to create an Amazon storefront as an influencer* , open storefront editing, update profile details, create an idea list, add qualifying products, write annotations, and publish the changes. A structured creator community for collaboration and learning can also help creators develop a repeatable content plan.


### Creating Shoppable Content: Idea Lists, Pins, and Videos


Build each asset around a shopping question. Idea lists organize products, pins direct attention to a recommendation, and videos demonstrate use, scale, texture, setup, or results. Film vertically with steady framing, clear speech, and enough product detail to identify the exact item.


### Understanding Onsite Commissions vs. Offsite Affiliate Links: The Earning Difference


Storefront approval does not automatically activate onsite commissions. Amazon requires three product review videos for manual placement review. Upload three distinct videos showing product knowledge, accurate identification, and practical buyer guidance. Use clean audio, stable lighting, readable product views, and a vertical composition suited to mobile viewing.


### Creator Hub Workflow: Tracking Performance and Affiliate Attribution


Use reporting to separate clicks, ordered items, shipped items, conversion activity, and commission earnings. Review performance by product, format, idea list, and traffic source where available. A video with many views but few product-page visits may need a clearer recommendation.
